identificationModule.briefTitle: Newly Emerging Immunotherapy for Pancreatic Cancer Treatment
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase Ib/II Platform Trial of Newly Emerging Immunotherapy for Pancreatic Cancer Treatment

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase Ib/II platform clinical study to evaluate the initial efficacy and safety of different novel immunotherapies in patients with advanced pancreatic cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The cohort A/B/C included patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer who had previously failed at least first line gemcitabine-based system therapy.The cohort D/E/F included patients with previously untreated systemic pancreatic cancer with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer.This study plans to first explore A/B/C cohort, and then start the D/E/F cohort after determining the safety.

armGroups.label: Cohort1: JS004+JS001+Irinotecan Liposome Injection+5-fluorouracil (5-FU)/leucovorin (LV)
armGroups.description: Participants with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer who had previously failed at least first line gemcitabine-based system therapy will receive JS004 and JS001 combined with chemotherapy (irinotecan liposome injection+5-FU/LV) until the treatment termination event specified in the protocol occurs.

armGroups.description: Participants with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer who had previously failed at least first line gemcitabine-based system therapy will receive JS015 and JS001 combined with chemotherapy (irinotecan liposome injection+5-FU/LV) until the treatment termination event specified in the protocol occurs.

interventions.name: JS001
interventions.description: 240 mg by IV infusionevery 3 weeks (Q3W), given on cycle day 1.

interventions.name: JS004
interventions.description: 200 mg by IV infusion Q3W, given on cycle day 1.

interventions.name: JS007
interventions.description: 3mg/kg by IV infusion Q3W, given on cycle day 1.

interventions.name: JS015
interventions.description: 600mg by IV infusion Q3W, given on cycle day 1.

interventions.name: Irinotecan Liposome Injection
interventions.description: 60 or 70 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion every 2 weeks (Q2W), given on cycle day 1.

interventions.name: 5-Fluorouracil (5-FU)
interventions.description: 2400mg/m\^2, intravenously, over 46 h on day 1, Q2W.

interventions.name: Leucovorin (LV)
interventions.description: 400mg/m\^2, intravenously, over 30 min on day 1, Q2W.

interventions.name: Nab paclitaxel
interventions.description: 125 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion Q3W, given on cycle day 1 and 8.

interventions.name: Gemcitabine
interventions.description: 1000 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion Q3W, given on cycle day 1 and 8.

primaryOutcomes.description: If less than 2 participants developed DLT during the safety observation period (one cycle after the first dose), follow-up first-line D/E/F cohort exploration should be considered. Otherwise, it is up to the investigator to decide the next research plan.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 21 days after the first dose was administered to each subject

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR was defined as the percentage of participants with a best overall response of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) based on RECIST 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR was defined as the percentage of participants with a best overall response of CR or PR based on RECIST 1.1.
DCR was defined as the percentage of cases with remission (PR + CR) and stable lesions (SD) after treatment was assessable based on RECIST 1.1.
DOR will be calculated from the date of the first evaluation showing PR, or CR, to the date of the first disease progression or death, whichever comes first and based on RECIST 1.1.

PFS is defined as the time from the first dose until objective tumor progression(PD), or death, whichever comes first and based on RECIST 1.1. At the end of the study, the time of last acquisition of living patients without PD was taken as the deleted data.
OS will be measured from the date of first dose to death from any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Abnormal Laboratory Values and/or Adverse Events That Are Related to Treatment
secondaryOutcomes.description: Adverse event (AE), abnormal laboratory examination, serious adverse event (SAE) related with the study drug judged using NCI-CTCAE V5.0 by investigator.
